op30 — 10 arms on GVR-base BEST/WORST synthetic-data extremesop30 — GVR-base 最优/最差合成数据极点上的 10 臂重测

2026-07-13 · umbriel-b200-047 (8× B200, sm_100) · branch omni/op21-gvr-prod · bucket indexer_topk_op_bench/op30_gvrbase_extremes/

op22-style 10-arm top-K kernel benchmark on two NEW synthetic scenarios defined relative to the GVR (cuteDSL) baseline itself: BEST = the (cfg, hr) pole where GVR-base runs fastest, WORST = where it runs slowest — chosen by an absolute-time calibration sweep (§0), NOT the op22 HLS-relative labels. Timing = nsys pure-kernel GPU time, cold-L2 canonical (20 reps, 512 MB evict) + warm-L2 (50 reps). All speedups = t(gvr_cutedsl)/t(op), >1 ⇒ op faster than the baseline. Single node, all arms read byte-identical bundles per cell.

op22 风格的 10 臂 top-K 内核基准，跑在两个以 GVR (cuteDSL) 基线自身定义的新合成场景上：BEST = GVR-base 最快的 (cfg, hr) 极点，WORST = 其最慢极点 —— 由 绝对时间定标扫描选出（§0），不是 op22 的 HLS-相对标签。计时 = nsys 纯 kernel GPU 时间，冷 L2 为规范口径（20 次， 每次 512 MB 清空）+ 热 L2（50 次）。所有加速比 = t(gvr_cutedsl)/t(op)，>1 ⇒ 该臂快于基线。单节点，同一 cell 全部臂读取 字节一致的 bundle。

0. Data calibration — deriving the GVR-base poles0. 数据定标 — GVR-base 极点的推导

How BEST/WORST were chosen. A phase-1 calibration sweep measured the absolute GVR-base (cuteDSL) cold-L2 kernel time over the full synth grid cfg∈{aggregate, beta_shallow, beta_moderate, beta_deep} × hr∈{0.05..0.90} (fp32, BS=1, N∈{16K, 64K, 256K}), scored each (cfg, hr) by its per-N-normalized geomean, and took BEST = argmin, WORST = argmax per model (pick_scen_op30.py → scen_op30.json). Poles: v4flash BEST=beta_shallow hr0.30 / WORST=beta_shallow hr0.90; v4pro BEST=aggregate hr0.15 / WORST=beta_deep hr0.85; v32 BEST=beta_shallow hr0.15 / WORST=aggregate hr0.85 — WORST/BEST time ratios 2.17× / 1.75× / 1.54×. The radix control's spread stays ≤1.04× on the same grid, confirming the poles are GVR-specific data sensitivity, not noise.

Contrast with op22. op22's poles were HLS-relative (BEST=hr0.55, WORST=beta_shallow hr0.05); for GVR-base those labels are reversed AND shifted: GVR-base is FAST at low hr (boundary misses put the mean(logits[preIdx]) threshold seed right at the K-th value → ev1 accepted) and SLOW at high hr (near-perfect hint pins the seed at the top-K median → guaranteed undershoot → extra full-row re-scans) — its true worst sits at hr 0.85–0.90, not at op22's 0.55 label. Hence this dedicated calibration instead of reusing the op22 poles.

BEST/WORST 如何选定。Phase-1 定标扫描测量 GVR-base（cuteDSL）的 绝对 cold-L2 内核时间，覆盖 cfg∈{aggregate, beta_shallow, beta_moderate, beta_deep} × hr∈{0.05..0.90}（fp32、BS=1、N∈{16K, 64K, 256K}），按 per-N 归一化几何均值打分，逐模型取 BEST = argmin、WORST = argmax （pick_scen_op30.py → scen_op30.json）。极点： v4flash BEST=beta_shallow hr0.30 / WORST=beta_shallow hr0.90； v4pro BEST=aggregate hr0.15 / WORST=beta_deep hr0.85； v32 BEST=beta_shallow hr0.15 / WORST=aggregate hr0.85 —— WORST/BEST 时间比 2.17× / 1.75× / 1.54×。radix 对照臂在同一网格上散布 ≤1.04×，证明极点是 GVR 特有的数据敏感性而非噪声。

与 op22 的对照。op22 的极点是 HLS-相对的（BEST=hr0.55、 WORST=beta_shallow hr0.05）；对 GVR-base 而言这套标签方向反转且位置偏移： GVR-base 在低 hr 时快（贴边界的 miss 使 mean(logits[preIdx]) 阈值种子恰落在 第 K 个值 → ev1 直接接受），高 hr 时慢（近乎完美的提示把种子钉在 top-K 中位数 → 必然 undershoot → 额外全行重扫）—— 其真实 worst 在 hr 0.85–0.90， 而不是 op22 标签的 0.55。因此单独做本次定标，而不复用 op22 极点。

Timing protocol

nsys pure-kernel GPU time via per-cell NVTX range projection (nvtx_kern_sum, the 512 MB L2-evict kernel filtered out; nvtx_gpu_proj_sum adds the *_span wall-clock columns for sglang_v2's PDL overlap). Per cell: 10 warmup, 50 warm-L2 reps (w|), 20 cold-L2 reps (c|, 512 MB evict before each launch — canonical metric), eager+sync inside the range, cudaProfilerApi window; protocol byte-identical to sweep_op22rr.py (harness/sweep_nsys.measure_cell).

Data provenance

Bundles from the indexer-topk-temporal-synth unified skill; per-cell seed = 42 + crc32("{K}|{N}") % 1e6 (op22 policy), shared across dtypes and scenarios' N-grid; bundles generated once and byte-identical across all 10 arms at every test point. Scenario cfg/hr per model from scen_op30.json (§0).

Node provenance

Single node umbriel-b200-047 (8× B200, sm_100), claim-queue sharding over the 8 GPUs (atomic mkdir per batch) — no cross-node anchor transfer; absolute µs are valid within this report.

Exactness

At BS=1, once per (arm, K, dtype, N): the arm's output index set is gathered from the fp32 row and its sorted value-multiset compared against torch.topk (GVR output order is atomicAdd-nondeterministic). The build asserts zero FAIL rows.

计时协议

nsys 纯 kernel GPU 时间，按 cell 的 NVTX 区间投影 （nvtx_kern_sum，512 MB L2 清空 kernel 已过滤； nvtx_gpu_proj_sum 额外给出 *_span 墙钟列，覆盖 sglang_v2 的 PDL 重叠）。每 cell：10 次 warmup、50 次热 L2 （w|）、20 次冷 L2（c|，每次启动前清空 512 MB —— 规范指标），区间内 eager+sync，cudaProfilerApi 窗口；协议与 sweep_op22rr.py（harness/sweep_nsys.measure_cell） 逐字节一致。

数据出处

Bundle 由统一 skill indexer-topk-temporal-synth 生成； 每 cell seed = 42 + crc32("{K}|{N}") % 1e6（op22 策略）， 跨 dtype 与场景 N 网格共享；每个测试点的输入在全部 10 个臂间字节一致 （生成一次、磁盘加载）。各模型场景 cfg/hr 见 scen_op30.json （§0）。

节点出处

单节点 umbriel-b200-047（8× B200，sm_100），8 GPU 认领队列分片 （每批 atomic mkdir）—— 无跨节点锚点迁移；绝对 µs 仅在本报告内有效。

精确性

BS=1 时，每 (arm, K, dtype, N) 一次：从 fp32 行 gather 该臂输出索引集， 排序值多重集与 torch.topk 对比（GVR 输出顺序 atomicAdd 非确定）。构建时断言零 FAIL 行。
